craft_notes: Sthāyin: one-vision (one-nature lights all; knowing and knowable ONE envisioned). Rows: row 3 (one-nature→envisioned). Close: envisioned (dṛṣṭa — the seeing-word: one vision SEEN). Rejected: 'subject-object unity' — killed: knowing-knowable kept (jñeya-jñāna as the verse's pair); 'illuminates' — killed: lighting kept (dīpana as kindling, active).

lines: Knowing-lighting all, by all self lighting:
l4.sanskrit_cite: jñānaprakāśakaṃ sarvaṃ sarveṇātmā prakāśakaḥ | ekam ekasvabhāvatvāt jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vibhāvyate

reads_against.argmap: How is everything lit? → From one-nature, one self lights all — knowing and knowable are one vision.
c1_essence: One-nature lighting all: knowing and known one vision.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness that ends in sovereignty)
